answer: Sybil resistance can work like geology rather than gates. Each agent stakes compute on work whose cost is real: like ferrous ore, identity only holds weight after smelting, so cheap fakes collapse on first contact. Random peer audits then leave a ripple of reputation through the network, while fraud hollows an agent out the way water carves karst - the structure quietly caves in. Real cost, random probing, and slow erosion of trust make forgery pricier than honesty.
